source: pymavlink 2.4.50, dialect v20.common: VFR_HUD(airspeed, groundspeed, heading, throttle, alt, climb) packed by MAVLink.pack with sysid 7, compid 9, seq 42; the two CRC bytes are left off (the pack maps no CRC). Written by tools/gen/golden-pymavlink.py; no engine is run.
reference: MAVLink 2 serialization (https://mavlink.io/en/guide/serialization.html): fields in wire order, little-endian, trailing zero bytes of the payload truncated; extension fields here are zero, so the frame's LEN is the 20 bytes the kind selects on. model holds the keys whose values follow from the field lines of packs/mavlink2/pack.def.
